sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
[[Sophie Casterwill]], [[Lok Lambert]] and [[Dante Vale]] stayed prior to their starting the mission, [[The Golem of Prague]]. Due to an unnamed double agent within the [[Huntik Foundation]], several [[Redcap]] [[Titans]] were hidden there to ambush them. It is also where they first met [[Zhalia Moon]] in the same episode when she used her [[Strix]] titans to help them {{source|Words of Truth, Heart of Lies}}.

Dante and [[Cherit]] taught Lok how to play the [[Huntik Trading Card Game]] here. {{Source|Huntik TCG Tutorial}}

Following their mission at the [[Road of Alchemists]], the Huntik team regrouped here with [[Lucas Casterwill]] and his team, after learning the location of the [[Amulet]] of [[Void]]. Lucas then told the team about the story of [[the Betrayer]]. {{source|Chasing Void}}

full_text:
The Prague Huntik Hotel is a safehouse owned by the Huntik Foundation located in the centre of Prague, Czech Republic.

History

Sophie Casterwill, Lok Lambert and Dante Vale stayed prior to their starting the mission, The Golem of Prague. Due to an unnamed double agent within the Huntik Foundation, several Redcap Titans were hidden there to ambush them. It is also where they first met Zhalia Moon in the same episode when she used her Strix titans to help them [Words of Truth, Heart of Lies].

Dante and Cherit taught Lok how to play the Huntik Trading Card Game here. [Huntik TCG Tutorial]

Following their mission at the Road of Alchemists, the Huntik team regrouped here with Lucas Casterwill and his team, after learning the location of the Amulet of Void. Lucas then told the team about the story of the Betrayer. [Chasing Void]
